title: Accessibility Basics
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting accessibility basics to accessibility revision pass, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Write alt text that conveys an image's meaning, not just its file name.
Use real heading styles so assistive technology can navigate the structure.
Ensure no information is carried by color alone.
Check text contrast against the [WCAG](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) threshold and fix failures.
